tools.name: nl_vehicle_basic
tools.description: Free. Use when the user gives a Dutch licence plate or asks about a specific car in the Netherlands: make, model, age, fuel, Euro class, APK (MOT) expiry, insurance, open recall, RDW odometer verdict and a risk level. Source: RDW.

tools.name: nl_car_model
tools.description: Free. Use when the user asks how reliable a car model is, or which used car to buy: facts for the model in the Netherlands from RDW data: APK (MOT) defect rate vs the average of all models, the 10 most common APK defects, recalls with component and risk, share with an open recall, share with an illo

tools.name: buy_full_vehicle_report
tools.description: Returns a secure payment link (iDEAL or card, via Dodo Payments, EUR 1.95 incl. VAT) for the full English vehicle report: APK inspection history with defects, recall details, import/taxi/export history, specs and catalogue price. Only use when the user wants the full report or asks to buy it.

tools.name: nl_vehicle_report
tools.description: Use when the user asks about a specific Dutch car or licence plate, for example before buying it used: make, model, APK expiry and full inspection history with defects, insurance, open recalls, RDW odometer verdict, import/taxi/export history, specs, CO2, catalogue price and risk flags, in English.

tools.name: nl_vehicle_compare
tools.description: Use when the user is choosing between 2 or 3 Dutch used cars: plates side by side with make, model, age, APK expiry, insurance, open recall, odometer verdict, import and taxi history, catalogue price, CO2 and power, the best per metric and red flags. Input: Dutch licence plates. Source: RDW. Costs 0

tools.name: nl_apk_alert
tools.description: Use when the user asks when a Dutch car's APK (MOT) expires or whether it is still valid: expiry date, days left and a status band (expired, due within 30 or 90 days, ok), with insurance and open-recall flags. Cheap enough to run daily for a fleet. Input: Dutch licence plate. Source: RDW. Costs 0.00
